findings.claim: The bundled skill described the repository as internal to Vercel.
findings.evidence: The compatibility frontmatter contained the internal-only sentence; the release commit removes it and documents public source installation.

findings.claim: The generic external-link filter discarded all Vercel deployment and documentation URLs.
findings.evidence: isNoiseUrl matched every vercel.com, vercel.app, vercel.dev, vercel.live, and vercel.link host; the vendor-wide rule was removed and regression cases now keep project.vercel.app and vercel.com/docs.

exemptions.claim: bun.lock did not change with package.json.
exemptions.evidence: Only package metadata, scripts, and publishing policy changed; no dependency version or resolution changed.
